corrigendum_2026_06_10_arc2.consistency_ensemble_micro_evidence: From saved histories: 3 tasks have >=2 INDEPENDENT demo-perfect programs; test-output agreement 2/3; agreed pairs are gold 3/3 (vs 0.50 unconditional) with a measured recall cost (446ef5d2's correct program disagreed with its wrong sibling). The k=2-3 independent-induction agreement gate is the precision fix to run next.
corrigendum_2026_06_10_arc2.contamination_audit_adjudicated: 0/23 probe tasks appear in ARC-AGI-2 training2 (removes the ARC-1 round's contamination channel), BUT 2/23 (16b78196, aa4ec2a5) are content-identical ARC-1-eval reuses (demos+test inputs+outputs identical; only demo order differs) and evaluation2 itself has been public since ~March 2025. Correct phrase: 'reduced-exposure, increased-difficulty transfer probe' — NEVER 'held-out' or 'contamination-free'.
corrigendum_2026_06_10_arc2.cost_framing: Correct per-task framing: ARC-2 251.3 s/unique-task vs ARC-1 46.2 (5.4x); 67.3% of ARC-2 codex-seconds burned on the 11 never-demo-perfect tasks; 5/56 calls died at the 300s timeout including ALL 3 iterations of 269e22fb (an oracle-hit task) — part of the venue degeneracy is infrastructure. Adaptive iteration caps + >=600s timeouts next time.
corrigendum_2026_06_10_arc2.file_hygiene: histories are duplicated per entry (naive recount 76 calls/8809.6s vs correct 56/5780.4s); the pool gz retains the builder name 'arc3_gap3_stage2_eval_pool' (provenance, not an error).
corrigendum_2026_06_10_arc2.gate_never_fired: pred_in_pool = 0/31: GAP4_GATED is bit-identical to TRM_VOTE; '0 recovered / 0 lost' is VACUOUS here, not a measured safety property. The 8 demo-perfect-but-wrong predictions are near-misses (6/8 same-shape, hamming 0.002-0.032) — at ~0.5 precision the ARC-1 '+4/-0' safety record must not be quoted forward.
corrigendum_2026_06_10_arc2.graded_signal: The one live rerank signal: 7b80bb43's demo-perfect prediction was 1/493 cells from gold (absent from pool); GRADED min-hamming promoted gold vote-rank 2->1 (GRADED pass@1 0.0645 > GATED 0.0323). Exact-match gating is too brittle on hard tasks; a graded execution-energy gate (demo_fit==1 AND min-hamming <= ~0.005) is the successor design — validate on the non-degenerate ARC-1 venue first.
corrigendum_2026_06_10_arc2.memorization_asymmetry: The load-bearing contamination evidence: demo-perfect-but-test-WRONG rises 3/29=10.3% (ARC-1) to 8/16=50% (ARC-2), Fisher p=0.0085 — memorization predicts the OPPOSITE signature (test-correct fits) — and the maximally-exposed task 16b78196 (verbatim 5-years-public ARC-1-eval reuse) fails completely at demo_fit 0.0 across all 3 iterations. Exposure does not function as recall in this pipeline. Corollary: ARC-1's 0.897 precision is an UPPER BOUND on genuine induction (measured on a maximally-contaminated pool); the design cannot decompose difficulty from residual contamination and claims neither separately.
